goal: Stage prepared local notes through insert-only Paper creation with durable intent and conservative restart reconciliation.
scope: Offline prepared disposable profiles with explicitly supplied publishing metadata
Bind each staging plan to source hashes and a captured local runtime identity
Preserve unknown, edited or ambiguous targets and all legacy navigation
No media upload, internal-link rewrite, authority switch, real-library migration, merge or deployment
acceptance: Intent is durable before every create; same prepared source and target resume without duplicate or overwrite
Process interruption after commit and before receipt reconciles exact content without blind replay
Changed source, corrupt plan or receipt, retargeted runtime and edited/draft targets stop safely
Actual private Paper API readback, relevant tests, root verification and reviewed visual evidence pass
nextAction: Implement the offline staging module and interruption tests; keep it outside UI until the full migration contract is proven.
